originality.rationale: Milojević–Sudakov's 2026 primary paper poses broad mean-crossing lower bound and proves limited p cases, not the full all-p at most five-support case or sharp light-stake stability. Fokkink–Meester–Pelekis optimize an upper probability over stakes, not the lower mean-threshold infimum. The 3/256 pair-combinatorial quantitative gap is additional; exact small-support prior results in older chance-constrained gambling literature remain possible.
